symbols.name: input bit length
symbols.meaning: The bit length of each input, a count of bits.
symbols.quote: Here $n$ is the bit length of each input, $T$ the transform size and $p$ the working precision in bits.

symbols.name: transform size
symbols.meaning: The transform size, the number of points in each transform.
symbols.quote: Here $n$ is the bit length of each input, $T$ the transform size and $p$ the working precision in bits.

symbols.name: working precision
symbols.meaning: The working precision in bits, a count of bits in each coefficient format.
symbols.quote: Here $n$ is the bit length of each input, $T$ the transform size and $p$ the working precision in bits.

symbols.name: volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored bits of the padded array, up to a constant, equal to $Tp$.
symbols.quote: Each stage is measured after division by the volume $V=Tp$, the number of stored bits up to a constant.

symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of the padded box, a count.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is the number of axes, $K$ the chunk width in bits and $\ell=\log_2 r$ the number of address bits in a record.

symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The width of each address chunk in bits, a count.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is the number of axes, $K$ the chunk width in bits and $\ell=\log_2 r$ the number of address bits in a record.

symbols.name: record address bits
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits in one record, a count, equal to $\log_2 r$.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is the number of axes, $K$ the chunk width in bits and $\ell=\log_2 r$ the number of address bits in a record.

symbols.name: size exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent in the sizes, with $d=\Theta(p^\epsilon)$.
symbols.quote: The fixed exponents are $\epsilon$ and $c$ in these sizes, $\tau$ and $\lambda'$ in the chunk and butterfly costs, and $\delta$ in the Gaussian costs.

symbols.name: chunk exponent
symbols.quote: The fixed exponents are $\epsilon$ and $c$ in these sizes, $\tau$ and $\lambda'$ in the chunk and butterfly costs, and $\delta$ in the Gaussian costs.

symbols.name: chunk-exchange exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent $\tau<1$ in the chunk-exchange cost $O(VK^\tau)$.
symbols.quote: The fixed exponents are $\epsilon$ and $c$ in these sizes, $\tau$ and $\lambda'$ in the chunk and butterfly costs, and $\delta$ in the Gaussian costs.

symbols.name: butterfly exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent $\lambda'<1$ in the simultaneous-round cost $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$.
symbols.quote: The fixed exponents are $\epsilon$ and $c$ in these sizes, $\tau$ and $\lambda'$ in the chunk and butterfly costs, and $\delta$ in the Gaussian costs.

symbols.name: Gaussian exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent in the Gaussian and chirp costs, here $\delta=1/16$.
symbols.quote: The fixed exponents are $\epsilon$ and $c$ in these sizes, $\tau$ and $\lambda'$ in the chunk and butterfly costs, and $\delta$ in the Gaussian costs.

symbols.name: resampling parameter
symbols.meaning: An integer parameter of the Gaussian maps, of order $p^{1/4+\epsilon/2}$.
symbols.quote: The Gaussian maps use an integer parameter $\alpha=\Theta(p^{1/4+\epsilon/2})$.

symbols.name: margin below one
symbols.meaning: The margin of row $i$ below one, so that row $i$ costs $p^{1-g_i}$.
symbols.quote: The seven largest exponents have margins $g_1,\dots,g_7$ below one, so row $i$ costs $p^{1-g_i}$:

symbols.name: exponent saving
symbols.meaning: The saving in the exponent of the final bound, $2^{-182}$.
symbols.quote: The exponent saving $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is half the smallest margin.

relations.quote: Summing them bounds the running time of [The multiplication algorithm](multiplication-algorithm.md) on $n$-bit inputs.
The chunk row rests on the cost of [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-chunk-interchange.md), with $O(VK^\tau)$ per exchange.
The simultaneous row is based on the cost of [Simultaneous normalized butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md), which costs $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ per round.
The Gaussian row follows from the line counts of [Tensor resampling on a padded box](tensor-resampling.md).
Together the rows bound the cost of [Convolution from the retained transform layout](synthetic-convolution.md).
Each power of $p$ below is set by the sizes in [Parameter choices for the padded box](parameter-choice.md).
